environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; pure pictorial storytelling; zero text, symbols, or UI charts.

visual_logic.composition: The scene uses a pure color-to-stone visual contrast to show time matching within a single frame. In the center, a beautifully colored Tapejara pterosaur is happily perched on a lush, vibrant green Ruffordia fern cluster next to a bright, blooming pink Endressinia flower. Everything they touch is full of life and color, showing they belong together. Right next to them, a plant from the wrong time period is drawn as a cold, lifeless grey stone statue, completely out of place in the warm environment, making it immediately obvious to a child that it doesn't belong to the living world of the pterosaur.
visual_logic.ground: Pale buff and cream-colored platy limestone floor.
visual_logic.background: Soft, muted coastal lowland haze with a distant, warm sunlit sky.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, clear daylight that illuminates the colorful, living elements while casting flat, dull shadows under the mismatched stone plant.
